def test_source_session_shares_one_role_assessment_without_repeated_scans(monkeypatch):
    from company_wiki.document_understanding.operating_states import assertion_roles
    from company_wiki.source_catalog.narrative_operating_relations import SourceOperatingSession
    from company_wiki.source_catalog.narrative_support_use import source_support_use
    from company_wiki.resource_budget import WorkBudget
    text="Our equipment is used by hospitals to sterilise surgical tools."
    parsed,_=source_fixture([(text,)])
    uid=parsed.units[0].unit_id
    session=SourceOperatingSession({uid:parsed.units[0]},work_budget=WorkBudget(100000))
    actual=assertion_roles.prepare_source_assertions
    calls=[]
    def observed(value):
        calls.append(value)
        return actual(value)
    monkeypatch.setattr(assertion_roles,"prepare_source_assertions",observed)
    for _ in range(4):
        fact=session.fact(uid)
        assert source_support_use(text,fact=fact,financial_only=session.financial_only(uid),
            source_relations=session.relations(uid),support_unit_ids=(uid,),
            source_roles=session.source_assertions(uid))[0]=="support"
    assert calls==[text] and session.complete

def test_explicit_manufacturing_argument_does_not_need_a_known_product_suffix(text):
    session, _ = session_for([text])
    uid = unit_id(0)
    assert observed_use(session, uid)[0] == 'unresolved'
    assert source_narrative_relevance(fact=session.fact(uid), source_roles=session.source_assertions(uid))
    result = session.relations(uid)
    bound = session.engine.relation_bindings(uid)
    assert not any(bound)
    assert session.engine.unknown_argument(uid)
    relations = result['relations']
    if 'currently manufacture qx' not in text:
        assert all(r['polarity'] == 'negative' for r in relations)
    assert all(r['object_refs'] for r in relations)
    for relation in relations:
        for ref in relation['object_refs']:
            assert text[ref['char_start']:ref['char_end']]
        if text.startswith('The supplier'):
            assert relation['attribution'] != 'issuer'

def test_real_source_selection_retains_distinct_business_information_in_twelve_spans(language):
    if language == "zh":
        noise = [f"本公司坚持以客户为中心，通过高质量服务提升客户研发效率，服务宗旨第{i}项。" for i in range(24)]
        facts = (SCOPES[0], GEOGRAPHIES[0], CONTRACTS[0],
                 "本公司新设备已交付海外客户，产线产能利用率达到85%。")
    else:
        noise = [f"Our service platform aims to improve customer efficiency and reduce customer costs, principle {i}."
                 for i in range(24)]
        facts = (SCOPES[2], GEOGRAPHIES[2], CONTRACTS[1],
                 "Our managed data platform charges customers based on storage consumed and computation used.")
    result = select_narrative_evidence(document((*noise, *facts), language), title="Annual report",
        existing_kind="annual_report", selector_version="0.9.0", max_selected=12)
    selected = {span.raw_text for span in result.evidence_spans}
    assert set(facts) <= selected
    assert len(result.evidence_spans) <= 12
    assert sum(len(span.raw_text or "") for span in result.evidence_spans) <= 48000

def test_source_disclosed_foreign_actor_is_preserved_without_issuer_or_consolidation_inference():
    text = "Independent Delta集團的品牌組合，包括NorthPeak、HarborSport及CedarActive，該集團為獨立上市公司，並非本公司合併分部。"
    source = source_id_for_sha256("c" * 64)
    unit = _make_unit(source_id=source, parser_version="0.1.1", coordinates=EvidenceCoordinates(paragraph_index=0),
        raw_text=text, unit_kind="html_paragraph", source_role="company_filing", language="mixed", metadata={})
    parsed = DocumentStructure(source, "c" * 64, "mixed", (unit,), mime_type="text/html", line_count=1)
    selected = select_narrative_evidence(parsed, title="Company update", selector_version="0.9.0", max_selected=8)
    assert [span.raw_text for span in selected.evidence_spans] == [text]
    assert selected.evidence_spans[0].coordinates == unit.coordinates
    assert "brand_portfolio_structure" in detect_reading_business_fact(text).reasons
    assert "consolidated" not in detect_reading_business_fact(text).reasons

def test_company_metric_definitions_are_readable_without_becoming_actual_metrics(text):
    fact = detect_reading_business_fact(text)

    assert fact.eligible
    assert fact.purpose == "operating_metric_basis"
    assert any(reason.startswith("reporting_metric_definition") for reason in fact.reasons)
    assert not {"operating_quantity", "operating_metric_change", "business_revenue_measure"} & set(fact.reasons)
    assert source_purpose(text) not in NON_OPERATING_PURPOSES

def test_updated_reporting_definition_survives_a_long_flat_native_paragraph():
    text = (
        "Azure revenue growth metric definition has been updated to reflect a move "
        "of services to a different reported business. "
        + "Prior metric descriptions and scope notes remain source context. " * 45
    )
    assert len(text) > 1200

    clauses = _reading_clauses(text)
    fact = detect_reading_business_fact(text)

    assert clauses and "Azure revenue growth metric definition" in clauses[0]
    assert fact.eligible
    assert "reporting_definition_change" in fact.reasons
    assert "reporting_metric_definition" in fact.reasons
    assert "operating_metric_change" not in fact.reasons
    assert _admitted(unit(text), {"section_role": "business"}, "background", fact=fact)[0]

def test_mechanical_outlook_recast_is_retained_without_inventing_growth():
    text = (
        "Our FY28 Q1 revenue outlook has only mechanical adjustments for the reporting "
        "changes; our total company revenue outlook is unchanged."
    )
    fact = detect_reading_business_fact(text)

    assert fact.eligible
    assert "reporting_outlook_recast" in fact.reasons
    assert "source_revenue_guidance" not in fact.reasons
    assert "operating_metric_change" not in fact.reasons
    assert _admitted(unit(text), {"section_role": "business"}, "background", fact=fact)[0]
